environment.description: Same Flask application deployed behind an internal NLB with TLS passthrough to an Envoy sidecar (v1.28). The Envoy listener is configured with a downstream TLS transport socket requiring client certificate presentation validated against an internal CA bundle (org-pki-intermediate-2024.pem). The require_client_certificate field is set to true in the DownstreamTlsContext. Additionally, the NLB target group health check path is /api/v2/migration/status (HTTP 200), confirming the app is reachable only through this path. The Envoy route configuration has a header match requiring x-envoy-client-cert-validated: true (injected by the TLS inspector filter after successful mTLS handshake) before forwarding to the upstream cluster. Client certificates are issued only to the internal migration-orchestrator service account via Vault PKI with a 4-hour TTL and CN=migration-svc.internal.corp.

config.network: private subnet, no internet gateway, VPC endpoint access only
config.cert_issuance: HashiCorp Vault PKI, role=migration-svc, ttl=4h, allowed_domains=internal.corp
